topic: Cheyava Falls leopard-spot rock on Mars
hook: Your Mars rover found a leopard-spotted rock.
title: A Leopard-Spotted Rock Found on Mars
description:
In 2024, NASA's Perseverance rover photographed a rock called Cheyava Falls with spots and streaks. NASA called it a possible sign of ancient microbial life. It is not proven, and the rover collected a sample for study.
